$comment: Impediment-production conformance. When an intent's GolemScript fails, the executor feeds the error back wrapped in a <golem:impediment phase="..."> envelope (Dialect M). The ENVELOPE (open tag + phase ∈ {COMPILATION, EVALUATION} + matching close tag + single trailing newline) is the language-neutral contract every harness MUST honour. `referenceMessage` is the EXACT output of the JVM/Kotlin reference executor and is implementation-specific (diagnostic text + stack frames); non-JVM harnesses validate the envelope only. Seeded verbatim from golem-xiv-core/src/test/kotlin/script/GolemScriptExecutorTest.kt.

cases.name: evaluation-runtime-exception
cases.referenceMessage:
<golem:impediment phase="EVALUATION">
java.lang.Exception: must fail
  at Script.invokeSuspend(golem-script.kts:1)
  | throw Exception("must fail")
</golem:impediment>
